per_row_intent_verdict_authority.note: the read re-derives the comparator's per-row verdict from the sealed PLAN arm's own official score as well and refuses on any disagreement.

comparator.role: sealed, already flown, never re-flown and not part of this campaign. It holds these 55 rows' comparator answers, and every one of them is intent-WRONG there: the bank's INTENT-UNCOVERED and INTENT-COVERED classes both collapse to INTENT-WRONG in its own convention. The probe therefore flies the TREATMENT ONLY and the contrast is per-row and offline.

boundary: A development read on a TRAIN construction fold (owner decisions 28 and 86); never a test claim, never a generalisation claim, and it admits nothing by itself. No utterance text, transcript, gold label string, intent name as content or model output is printed or persisted: ids, counts, rates and hashes only.

interval.no_bootstrap_because: the estimand is one binomial proportion over independent rows, not a paired difference of pooled metrics

reported_beside_every_number: the flown delivery check against the offline derivation's 55 (the gate)
the reverse count and the statement that it is zero by construction
the four-way transition split and the stay-wrong split
the re-declaration arithmetic and the 27-row threshold, stated and not applied
GOLD-SELECTED ROSTER: conditional rate only, no pooled or roster-level claim, and this cell cannot see harm on already-correct rows or on rows that lose their gold entry
steps: 1. Refuse unless the sealed manifest is COMPLETE at 55 rows and its ids equal the committed roster's ids exactly (compare the id-list sha256, not a count), and the manifest's config hash is this cell's (the centroid file is what flew).

2. THE DELIVERY GATE: refuse unless the flown Perception consumption delivered the row's own gold intent boundary value id on all 55 rows. The offline derivation predicts 55; anything less is an engineering defect and closes the read with no conversion number (a refusal receipt is written instead).
3. Score once over the complete manifest with the dataset's standard scorer (slurp-slu-official-train through core.scoring_batch, never sharded) and take ONE field per row: scenario_action_exact.

4. Establish the comparator's per-row intent verdict two ways and refuse on any disagreement: from the bad-case bank (plan_class INTENT-UNCOVERED or INTENT-COVERED, both intent-wrong, digest pinned above) and from the sealed PLAN arm's own official score for the same sample ids.

5. m = the count of rows whose probe verdict is exact and whose comparator verdict is not. r = the reverse count, which must be 0 because every comparator verdict on this roster is wrong; a non-zero r means the roster or the comparator was misread and closes the read.
6. Report P(correct | newly delivered) = m / 55 with a Wilson score CI95 and the exact Clopper-Pearson CI95 beside it. No bootstrap: the quantity is a single binomial proportion.

7. Report the FOUR-WAY transition split (wrong to gold; gold to wrong; the same wrong intent; a different wrong intent) and the stay-wrong split (byte-identical answer; same wrong intent in different bytes; different wrong intent), with the within-pair byte identity on rows whose intent did not change as context beside the ROLL-AA null, never against it.

8. State the re-declaration arithmetic and do not apply it: a later construction cell's expected_effect_pp = m x 0.092615 pp intent accuracy (owner decision 133) and m x 0.041615 pp SLU-F1 for the guard; state whether m >= 27 (the 2.5 pp intent bar at n = 1,080); and state in the same paragraph that this is a CONDITIONAL rate on a gold-selected roster and not a pooled effect.
title: Cell KPROBE -- P(correct | newly delivered), the centroid key's conversion from delivery to correctness, measured
